description: List the voices available for text-to-speech. Use a voice's `id` as `style.voice_name` in the AI Voice Generator API. To fetch the next page, pass the response's next_cursor as cursor.

cursor.description: Opaque pagination cursor from the previous response's next_cursor.

limit.description: Maximum number of voices to return. Defaults to 20.

name: voices_list

next_cursor.description: Cursor for the next page, or null when there are no more voices.

avatar_url.description: URL of the voice's avatar image, or null when the voice has no avatar.

id.description: Unique ID of the voice. Pass it as `style.voice_name` when generating speech. Names are not unique, so use the ID.

preview_url.description: URL of an audio sample of the voice.

title: List voices
